correctness.rationale: The independent left/right Demazure multiplication conditions yield an exhaustive D/F dichotomy for each simple generator. The four simultaneous cases partition the centralizer: full-fixed factorial count, two independently constrained mixed completion counts, and a D,D count equal to the number of parabolic S3-double cosets. The latter is the count of partial bijections of the n-3 point complement with at most three omitted domain/range points. All boundary formulas and the n=3 exception are explicit. Direct independent-product enumeration checked n=3..9 and all four strata; finite checks are not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Common centralizers of adjacent standard generators are canonical invariants for the finitely presented 0-Hecke monoid. The theorem classifies their size at every position, proves a sharp convex boundary-to-center separation, gives all distinct-size multiplicities and a uniform 1/36 limiting density, and contrasts them with the much smaller simultaneous centralizers in the symmetric group. The structural D/F decomposition explains why simple-generator conjugacy in S_n does not predict 0-Hecke centralizer size; it is a natural complete census, not a numerical micro-improvement.
